import unittest
from datetime import date
from solution import prepare_expedition


class ExpeditionExplicitFinishTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_present_finish_must_be_date(self):
        data = dict(name='Trip', brief='Map', division='Science', leader='Asha',
                    start=date(2028, 3, 4), finish=None)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            prepare_expedition(data, ['Science'], ['Asha'])


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()

import unittest
from collections import OrderedDict
from datetime import date

from solution import prepare_expedition


class PrepareExpeditionTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.divisions = ["Science", "Logistics"]
        self.leaders = ("Asha", "Biren")
        self.minimum = {
            "name": "  Aurora  ",
            "brief": "  Map the ridge  ",
            "division": " Science ",
            "leader": " Asha ",
            "start": date(2028, 3, 4),
        }

    def test_minimum_record_is_normalized_with_defaults_and_exact_order(self):
        result = prepare_expedition(self.minimum, self.divisions, self.leaders)
        self.assertIs(type(result), dict)
        self.assertEqual(
            list(result),
            ["name", "brief", "division", "leader", "start", "finish",
             "accepting_members", "sponsored", "tags"],
        )
        self.assertEqual(result["name"], "Aurora")
        self.assertEqual(result["brief"], "Map the ridge")
        self.assertEqual(result["division"], "Science")
        self.assertEqual(result["leader"], "Asha")
        self.assertEqual(result["start"], date(2028, 3, 4))
        self.assertIsNone(result["finish"])
        self.assertIs(result["accepting_members"], False)
        self.assertIs(result["sponsored"], False)
        self.assertEqual(result["tags"], [])

    def test_all_optional_fields_and_tag_copying(self):
        tags = ["ice", "Ice", "ice"]
        data = dict(self.minimum)
        data.update({
            "finish": date(2028, 3, 4),
            "accepting_members": True,
            "sponsored": True,
            "tags": tags,
        })
        original = dict(data)
        result = prepare_expedition(data, self.divisions, self.leaders)
        self.assertEqual(result["tags"], tags)
        self.assertIsNot(result["tags"], tags)
        result["tags"].append("new")
        self.assertEqual(tags, ["ice", "Ice", "ice"])
        tags.append("input-only")
        self.assertNotIn("input-only", result["tags"])
        self.assertEqual(data["name"], original["name"])
        self.assertEqual(data["brief"], original["brief"])

    def test_input_mapping_order_does_not_control_output_order(self):
        data = OrderedDict([
            ("start", date(2029, 1, 1)),
            ("leader", "Biren"),
            ("division", "Logistics"),
            ("brief", "Supply"),
            ("name", "North"),
        ])
        result = prepare_expedition(data, self.divisions, self.leaders)
        self.assertEqual(list(result), [
            "name", "brief", "division", "leader", "start", "finish",
            "accepting_members", "sponsored", "tags",
        ])

    def test_missing_required_and_unknown_fields_raise_value_error(self):
        for missing in ("name", "brief", "division", "leader", "start"):
            data = dict(self.minimum)
            del data[missing]
            with self.subTest(missing=missing):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    prepare_expedition(data, self.divisions, self.leaders)
        data = dict(self.minimum, unexpected=1)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            prepare_expedition(data, self.divisions, self.leaders)

    def test_invalid_required_values_raise_value_error(self):
        invalid_by_field = {
            "name": ["", "   ", 3, None],
            "brief": ["", "\t", [], None],
            "division": ["", "Unknown", 4],
            "leader": ["", "Nobody", False],
            "start": ["2028-03-04", None, 4],
        }
        for field, values in invalid_by_field.items():
            for value in values:
                data = dict(self.minimum)
                data[field] = value
                with self.subTest(field=field, value=value):
                    with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                        prepare_expedition(data, self.divisions, self.leaders)

    def test_invalid_optional_values_raise_value_error(self):
        cases = [
            ("finish", "later"),
            ("finish", date(2028, 3, 3)),
            ("accepting_members", 1),
            ("accepting_members", None),
            ("sponsored", 0),
            ("sponsored", "yes"),
            ("tags", ("ice",)),
            ("tags", ["ice", ""]),
            ("tags", ["ice", 4]),
        ]
        for field, value in cases:
            data = dict(self.minimum)
            data[field] = value
            with self.subTest(field=field, value=value):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    prepare_expedition(data, self.divisions, self.leaders)

    def test_non_mapping_data_raises_value_error(self):
        for value in (None, [], "record", 3):
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    prepare_expedition(value, self.divisions, self.leaders)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
